turns.text:
ok can u help me word a text to my coworker pls

hes asking me to cover another saturday swap. like the third one. i already work sat and sun 6:30 to 1 and i have anatomy reading i need to catch up on

Happy to help. Here's a friendly, clear decline:

"Hey! I can't cover this Saturday. I'm already working my regular Sat/Sun shifts and I'm behind on reading for class, so I need the time. Hope you find someone, sorry I can't help this time!"

Want it shorter or a bit warmer?

hmm its kind of blunt..

also jun is already dealing with paolo flaking on prep stuff so i feel bad adding to the flake pile at work lol

Totally understandable. Saying no to a swap isn't flaking, though. Declining upfront is actually the more reliable thing for the schedule. Here's a softer version that's still clear:

"Hey! I wish I could, but I can't take this Saturday. I've got my usual shifts and a lot of reading to catch up on. Hope you find someone soon!"

Want me to adjust it?

ok wait what if i just say maybe

like "hey let me see if i can make it work, maybe?"

I can write that, but a "maybe" may leave your coworker waiting and hoping, and you might end up with the same decision later. Here's the maybe version:

"Hey! Let me see how my week shapes up and I'll let you know. Might be tough with my usual shifts and class stuff though!"

If you want a bit more certainty, you could add a deadline like "I'll confirm by [day]." That way you aren't stuck with an open question.

yeah ill just send the maybe one and sort it out later 🫠

thanks
Sounds good. Go ahead and send it. If you decide later, a short "sorry, I can't make it work" text will do. Good luck with the reading! ☕
